emails.body:
Hi,

I am the consultant managing the <<AssessmentType>> assessment that has been scheduled with you. I am just sending a quick email to let you know that testing for this project has begun.

If I have any issues or require additional information, I will reach out. If you have any questions during the engagement, please feel free to contact me directly.

Many Thanks,

emails.body:
Hi,
